regionFills.notes: Cape Verde: Portuguese colony administered from Lisbon.
Greenland: Danish colony (administered under US protection during the war, returned to Copenhagen in 1945).
Comoros: dependency of the Colony of Madagascar.
Christmas Island: British, attached to the Straits Settlements.
Cocos (Keeling) Islands: British, attached to the Straits Settlements.
Nauru: League mandate administered by Australia; Japanese occupation ended in September 1945.
Rotuma: dependency of the Colony of Fiji.
